game.title: Knight's Tour
game.clickToPlace: Click a square to place the knight!
game.moveKnight: Move the knight in an L shape!

gameOver.title: Game Over!
gameOver.perfect: INCREDIBLE! You completed the entire board!

help.title: How to Play
help.objectiveText: Visit as many squares as possible by moving the knight without repeating any square.
help.movementText: The knight moves in an L shape:
help.movementOption1: 2 squares in one direction + 1 square perpendicular
help.movementOption2: Or 1 square in one direction + 2 squares perpendicular
help.scoringText: Your score is the number of visited squares. Maximum is 100 (all squares!).
